picks.thesis: Cleanest convergence in the book: a bipartisan congressional cluster (Fields, Cisneros, Letlow, Allen) sits alongside eleven non-10b5-1 open-market insider buys dated 2026-06-05 (lag 4), led by Chairman/CEO Wei Che-Chia and Co-COO Mii, with VP Yuan adding ~$79k on 06-22. Congress buys are small ($1-15k bands) and older (Jan-May), but the insider wave is fresh and spans the executive bench. Price sits near the 90-day low (415.58 vs 381.77 low, 477.57 high), down 4.8% in 30 days — insiders buying into weakness. Amount bands are ranges, not exact sizes.
key_risks: Congressional legs are small ($1-15k bands) and several are months stale (Jan-May).
Insider buys all cluster on a single date (06-05), so breadth of timing is narrow.
Price is near the 90-day low and down over 30 days; buying could be early.
picks.invalidation: TSM insiders or the congressional cluster begin filing sales, or the stock breaks below its 90-day low (381.77) without further insider buying.

Speculative until follow-through buying appears at market prices.

Stock is down 27% in 30 days and near its 90-day low — a falling knife.
Only one small congressional buy corroborates.
picks.invalidation: No further insider buying emerges at market prices, or the stock breaks below its 90-day low (51.40).
